question: Whose sixfold quality has been stated in this teaching context?
premises: A sixfold quality has been described.
The possessor is the maker of the world.
That maker is identified as Śiva.
inference: Thus the sixfold quality of Śiva, the maker of the world, has been stated here.
plain_english: Thus the sixfold quality of Śiva, the maker of the world, has been stated here.
